reason: The two films are pixel-identical in the curb, cab, creek, street flood, count grid, wheels-water, limits, fleet and close. They differ in the map (s2 shot 1), record (s5 and s7 shot 1) and lane (s6 shot 1) shots. The lane shot decides it. rejected_reason: In b, the s6 overhead lane at 28.4-32.6 s shows a car about an eighth of frame width. Its brake state is two tiny red dots from 30.8 s. The slow-then-roll-in turn is harder to read at phone size. b's overhead map and flat record cards add no information over a's. Both films carry the same creek defect.
